# B"H — Lexicon Binary Format (geelooy/api/social/helper/search/lexicon/binary/)

Binary record format for the search lexicon.

- `recordSchema.js` — binary record schema.
- `recordWriter.js`, `recordReader.js`, `recordCursor.js` — write, read, and cursor through binary records.
